content:
- Read saved progress (empty) and loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill plus smell docs.
- Inspected src/tests for one concrete boundary issue and avoided unrelated user-edited files in src/process/worker.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs.
- Chose the CLI connection output boundary: command/mod.rs manually builds conninfo strings even though pginfo/conninfo.rs is the canonical conninfo parse/render layer.
- Found the reason for the duplicate boundary: PgConnInfo currently does not render or parse sslcert/sslkey, so command/mod.rs had its own ad-hoc DSN builder.
- Next: extend PgConnInfo to cover sslcert/sslkey, switch CLI connection targets to own canonical PgConnInfo, delete the ad-hoc command rendering/materialization layer, then run make lint and make test.

- Implemented the boundary refactor in three places.
- Extended PgConnInfo parse/render to include sslcert and sslkey using file-backed SecretSource for conninfo materialization.
- Removed the command-layer custom DSN builder and wrapper DTOs so primary/replica command output now renders directly from typed StateDerivedConnectionCommandDto targets carrying PgConnInfo.
- Updated cli/connect to materialize typed PgConnInfo targets directly, including TLS path validation and mTLS file paths.
- Added focused unit coverage in src/command/mod.rs and strengthened existing conninfo tests.
- cargo check --all-targets now passes.
- Next: run make lint, fix anything it reports, then run make test, commit including .ralph files, push, and task switch.

- make lint passed after flattening PgConnInfo client_key from generic SecretSource to plain PathBuf, which removed the invalid conninfo state and satisfied clippy.
- make test passed: 230 tests run, 230 passed, 16 skipped; nextest reported 4 leaky tests but the target succeeded.
- Working tree still contains unrelated pre-existing edits in src/process/worker.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs; do not include them in this boundary-refactor commit.
- Next: commit only my source changes plus requested .ralph files, push the branch, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
